sources.publication_gate: Only rows in a document's current `products` array count; archive, quarantine, gaps, missing files, and superseded products do not.

releases.name: Foundation
releases.summary: Core spectroscopy pipeline, abundance engines, provenance framework, data architecture, validation tooling, and open-science infrastructure established. Ongoing R&D continues as normal scientific development.

releases.name: Alpha Release — Full Solar Calibration
releases.summary: Reviewed elemental abundances for the Sun across the strongest valid wavelength regions and available engines.
notes: Published for the Sun: Fe (I and II), C, O, Si, N, Al.

releases.name: Beta Release — Alpha Centauri A & B
releases.summary: The solar multi-band, multi-engine method extended independently to both Alpha Centauri components, including Codex-generated 3D model tests where scientifically justified and computationally ready.
